meta.name: apollo-cost-tuning
meta.description:
Optimize Apollo.io costs and credit usage.
Use when managing Apollo credits, reducing API costs,
or optimizing subscription usage.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo cost", "apollo credits",
"apollo billing", "reduce apollo costs", "apollo usage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 减少Apollo额度消耗,降低账单开销
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在用Apollo.io且觉得套餐太贵
copy.tagline_en: Trim your Apollo.io usage and cut subscription costs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Apollo.io and want to spend less

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按指南实施 Apollo.io 成本优化:产出成本感知缓存策略、去重服务、搜索评分、用量跟踪与超支告警,以及预算感知的 API 客户端。
howto.when: 当你说出 “apollo cost”“apollo credits”“apollo billing” 等短语,或要求管理 Apollo 积分、降低 API 成本、优化订阅用量时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 Apollo 项目加上成本感知缓存策略
say.note: 会生成缓存策略,减少重复 API 请求。

say.text: 设置 Apollo 用量超支提醒,超额就告警
say.note: 会加入用量跟踪与超支告警功能。

say.text: 检查 Apollo 数据里的重复记录并去重
say.note: 会生成去重服务,避免重复消耗积分。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude implements Apollo.io cost optimization: it produces a cost-aware caching strategy, a deduplication service, search scoring, usage tracking with alerts, and a budget-aware API client to reduce credit/API usage.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like "apollo cost", "apollo credits", "apollo billing", or ask to manage Apollo credits, reduce API costs, or optimize subscription usage.

say_en.text: Add a cost-aware caching strategy to my Apollo project.
say_en.note: Generates a caching strategy to cut duplicate API requests.

say_en.text: Set up Apollo usage alerts so I know when we exceed budget.
say_en.note: Adds usage tracking and over-budget alerts.

say_en.text: Check my Apollo data for duplicates and dedupe them.
say_en.note: Creates a deduplication service to avoid wasted credits.
